t: None of the funds authorized to be appropriated by this Act or otherwise made available for fiscal year 2020 for the Air Force may be obligated or expended to reduce the number of KC–10 aircraft in the primary mission aircraft inventory of the Air Force.

fable.w: This section is a funding limitation that bars the Air Force from using fiscal year 2020 funds to reduce the number of KC-10 aircraft in its primary mission inventory. There is no tempting reading here: it contains no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government is involved in any decision.

opus.w: This section only bars Air Force funds from being used to reduce the KC–10 inventory. No one outside the federal government is consulted or involved in any decision. Although it limits a federal action, it sets up no comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue, so it does not meet the definition of participation.
opus.s: None of the funds authorized to be appropriated by this Act or otherwise made available for fiscal year 2020 for the Air Force may be obligated or expended to reduce the number of KC–10 aircraft
